$comment: Needs phrased the way briefs and builders phrase them, each with the component(s) that answer it. `split` is tuning or heldout: scripts/find-lexicon.json and the weights in scripts/find.mjs are tuned against the tuning split only; the held-out split is run once at the end and is the honest number. Any of `expect` in position 1 is a top-1 hit; in positions 1-3 a top-3 hit. The first seven are the real misses that prompted this (2026-10-20).
